# submission_prep — non-author-dependent formatting aids (nothing submitted)

* `MANUSCRIPT_R2.tex` — pandoc "standalone" LaTeX of `../MANUSCRIPT_R2.md` (plain article class; figure paths point to `../figures/*.png`; citations are author-year text, not `\cite` commands). A starting point only.
* `references.bib` — 32 entries generated by `../tools/build_bib.py` from the Crossref/OpenAlex-checked metadata (`../REFERENCE_AUDIT.csv`, `../REFERENCE_CLAIM_CHECK.csv`).
* `../build/MANUSCRIPT_R2_review_copy.pdf` — review rendering (not a venue layout; not inspected page by page).

## Not done (author / venue steps)

1. **Venue template.** TMLR requires a PDF built with its LaTeX style file (author guide, read 2026-10-22); the style file was not downloaded. Obtain it from the official TMLR source, convert the text, convert citations to `\citep`/`\citet` with `references.bib`, embed `../figures/*.pdf`.
2. **Anonymisation (TMLR is double-blind):** the draft contains no author names, but it mentions "a previous study in this project", file paths of the repository and an AI-assistant statement; check each for identifying information before submission. Complete OpenReview profiles are required.
3. **Declarations** (`[AUTHORS TO COMPLETE]` in §14) and the venue's own AI-use statement.
4. **Supplementary material:** code, configuration, hashes and aggregate tables may be packaged (TMLR: PDF or ZIP, ≤ 100 MB); **do not include `results/**/predictions.npz`, `results/**/fits/` or any M5 file.**
